name: @hraness/atet
description: Atet, named for Ra's solar barque, is an open-source TypeScript SDK and Bun CLI for carrying ideas and raw assets into images, diagrams, animated loops, and video.

scripts.build: bun run build:sdk && bun run build:desktop && bun run build:web
scripts.build:sdk: bun -e 'await (await import("node:fs/promises")).rm("./dist", { recursive: true, force: true })' && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/cli.ts ./src/code/index.ts ./src/code/advanced.ts ./src/generate.ts ./src/host-resources.ts ./src/operations.ts ./src/workflow.ts ./src/vectorize/worker.ts --outdir ./dist --root ./src --target bun --format esm --splitting --packages external
scripts.build:desktop: bun run build:desktop:cli && bun run build:desktop:frontend && bun run build:desktop:runtime
scripts.build:desktop:cli: bun -e 'await (await import("node:fs/promises")).rm("./apps/desktop/dist/cli", { recursive: true, force: true })' && bun build --target=bun --minify --sourcemap=none --packages external --external @hraness/atet/cli apps/desktop/cli/main.ts --outdir apps/desktop/dist/cli && bun build --target=bun --minify --sourcemap=none --packages external --external '*main.js' apps/desktop/cli/transmute.ts --outdir apps/desktop/dist/cli
scripts.build:desktop:frontend: vite build --config apps/desktop/frontend/vite.config.ts && bun run check:desktop:direct-boundary
scripts.build:desktop:runtime: bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap=none apps/desktop/runtime/src/main.ts --outfile apps/desktop/runtime/dist/atet-gateway && bun run check:desktop:direct-boundary
scripts.dev:desktop: bun run build:desktop:runtime && bun run ./apps/desktop/runtime/run-native.ts dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:sdk && bun run typecheck:desktop
scripts.lint: bun run lint:sdk && bun run lint:desktop
scripts.lint:desktop: eslint apps/desktop/contracts apps/desktop/core apps/desktop/application apps/desktop/code apps/desktop/workflows apps/desktop/html-overlay apps/desktop/cli apps/desktop/capture apps/desktop/analysis apps/desktop/runtime apps/desktop/frontend apps/desktop/direct
scripts.test: bun run test:sdk && bun run test:desktop && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.test:desktop:macos: bun run build:desktop:capture:macos && bun test ./apps/desktop/capture/interruption-state.macos.test.ts ./apps/desktop/capture/timeline-prepared.macos.test.ts ./apps/desktop/capture/controller-orchestration.macos.test.ts ./apps/desktop/capture/finalization-state.macos.test.ts ./apps/desktop/capture/start-coordinator.macos.test.ts ./apps/desktop/capture/recorder-single-flight.macos.test.ts ./apps/desktop/capture/native-interruptions.macos.test.ts && bun run build:desktop:analysis:macos && bun test ./apps/desktop/analysis && bun run ./apps/desktop/runtime/run-zig.ts build test -Dplatform=macos
scripts.build:desktop:macos: bun run build:desktop:capture:macos && bun run build:desktop:analysis:macos && bun run build:desktop:frontend && bun run build:desktop:runtime && bun run ./apps/desktop/runtime/run-zig.ts build -Dplatform=macos -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
scripts.start:desktop:macos: bun run build:desktop:capture:macos && bun run build:desktop:analysis:macos && bun run build:desktop:runtime && bun run ./apps/desktop/runtime/run-native.ts run
scripts.package:desktop:macos: bun run build:desktop:capture:macos && bun run build:desktop:analysis:macos && bun run build:desktop:frontend && bun run build:desktop:runtime && bun run ./apps/desktop/runtime/run-zig.ts build package -Dplatform=macos -Dpackage-target=macos && bun run ./apps/desktop/runtime/package-macos.ts
scripts.test:cli:compiled:macos: bun run build:cli:macos && ATET_RUN_COMPILED_CLI_SMOKE=1 bun test ./apps/desktop/cli/compiled-portable-surface.macos.test.ts
scripts.verify:html-overlay:macos: bun run test:html-overlay:browser:macos && bun run test:html-overlay:operation:macos
scripts.check:sdk: bun run typecheck:sdk && bun run lint:sdk && bun run build:sdk && bun run test:sdk && bun run check:release-workflows && bun run check:schema && bun run check:skill
scripts.check:desktop: bun run typecheck:desktop && bun run lint:desktop && bun run test:desktop && bun run build:desktop
scripts.check: bun run check:standalone && bun run check:sdk && bun run check:desktop && bun run check:web && bun run check:standalone && bun run test:package
